claude_proposed_widenings.name: AdvantagePenaltyOperation (OngoingOperation variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Blur's core mechanic is a persistent advantage/disadvantage modifier that lasts for the concentration duration. The OngoingOperation union currently only has RollModifierOperation (dice addend, Bless-style) and DamageOnHitOperation. Neither fits. The EffectAtom already has modify_roll_advantage, but OngoingOperation does not include it as a valid operation kind. Adding a third variant — or allowing modify_roll_advantage EffectAtom directly as an OngoingOperation — would cover Blur and any similar ongoing advantage/disadvantage spells (Greater Invisibility, etc.).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For the duration, any creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: sense_immunity filter on OngoingOperation (or EffectAtom modifier)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Blindsight/Truesight immunity clause requires a conditional filter on the effect: the disadvantage does not apply if the attacker perceives the caster with a named sense. No existing surface type carries a per-effect exception predicate keyed on sense kind. This is a secondary gap — the primary encoding already fails on the operation variant, but the filter would need to be added alongside it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: An attacker is immune to this effect if it perceives you with Blindsight or Truesight.
